text_description: Full-length runway look cropped from head to upper thighs, centered on an open, long white coat worn over a matching pastel printed two-piece. The coat has a straight, slightly oversized silhouette with dropped-looking volume through the shoulders and long loose sleeves, a wide turned-up collar, and an open front that falls vertically down the body; its white surface appears richly textured with a subtle raised or quilted/bouclé-like effect. Dense multicolored trim borders the collar, front opening, and cuffs, combining small red, green, black, cream, and metallic-looking tufts or beads for a tactile embellished edge. A row of round silver-toned buttons is visible along one front side of the coat, while a deep burgundy lining flashes inside near the lower opening. Underneath, the model wears a very cropped pastel floral or abstract-printed tie-front top in pale pink, turquoise, coral, and green tones, forming a plunging V neckline and knot at the bust with dangling scarf-like ends, leaving the midriff and navel exposed. The coordinating low-rise mini skirt sits at the hips in the same soft multicolor print, cut short and close to the body with a raw, fringed hem and scattered shimmering or embroidered surface details. The styling emphasizes an ornate resort-couture mood: plush white outerwear framing a delicate, barely-there printed set with bright handcrafted trims and frayed textile edges. Footwear is not visible.
